system.story: Air and water answering to will - mobility and control, favoring cold, lightning, and sonic.

description.value:
Subclass: Stormcaller. You channel air and water - the mobile, controlling half of the Elementalist's craft. Your workings favor cold, lightning, and sonic damage, and you lean on forced movement to control the field rather than raw destruction.

Identity Feature - Enlarged Forced Movement

Whenever one of your abilities would push, pull, or slide a creature, the distance is increased - your storm doesn't just hit, it moves things.

Signature Summon

Your Summon Elemental heroic calls an air or water elemental rather than fire or earth, matching your Stormcaller attunement.
